text:
Here is the English translation:

> “If, in that very place, even a single doubt about adultery is considered a grave obstacle, then, as I have said, the work should be undertaken without any cause, because the very doubt itself, being more intense than a blow, has been removed. Indeed, that is the only thing that can be called doubt; in that which is called doubt, diseases and the like do not increase. It was said: ‘Disease is the cause of doubt.’ (Nyāya‑Kūṭa, Sutra 3/7).”
